title: Iya Ngozi Kitchen
description: A FastAPI + SQLModel service for a multi-branch Enugu restaurant: browse the menu per branch, register/sign in, place and track orders — plus staff-only dish and order management, role-gated.
highlights: Multi-branch data model: 3 branches, 5 categories, 20 dishes with per-branch prices and availability
Cookie session auth with Argon2 password hashing via pwdlib
Role-gated staff routes for dish and order management
Idempotent seed script — safe to re-run
Seeded with 10 customers, 3 staff, and 20 orders for realistic testing
problem: A restaurant with multiple branches needs a menu that differs by location — different dishes, different prices, different availability — while keeping a single ordering and auth system.
constraints: All routes under /api/v1 with interactive docs at /docs
Public menu endpoints must require no auth
architecture: Domain layout: app/public, app/user/{auth,orders}, app/staff, app/utils
BranchMenu join table models per-branch dish availability and pricing
Seed module is idempotent and safe to re-run
decisions: Used SQLite to keep the project runnable with a single command, trading production realism for developer experience
Modeled per-branch pricing explicitly rather than a single global price, because that is how the business actually works
Kept auth cookie-based rather than JWT for a server-rendered-friendly session model
